purpose: Machine-read atlas geometry contract, versioned path patterns and species list for the monster art tools. Pose structure is owned by _shared/mob-animation-template.json; folder layout by README.md.

frameOrder: idle S SE E NE N NW W SW

notes: These 23 baseline atlases are approved for the live ARPG battlefield; each root meta.json records the actual source PNG size and frame bounds.
Variant drafts were generated as 8 facings x 1 frame per state (40 cells). Production pose structure is owned by the mold; the runtime consumes east/west x4 rows. Remap before runtime registration.

All 156 existing variant drafts were normalized in place to 384 x 384 cells with the required 24 px gutters and passed atlas QA. They remain review candidates: each action/direction still has one pose, so they are not animated gait or runtime-complete. Runtime registration and production approval remain separate work.

productionPlayerSet: art-reference/players/one-handed-sword (staged from equipment-v1; status unbaked-staging). Legacy pilot art-reference/monsters/player retired and removed.
